target_customer: US hardware companies in aerospace, defense and space (customers listed include Anduril, Mach Industries, Relativity Space, Castelion, Planet Labs)
problem: Getting custom machined and fabricated parts from qualified US suppliers is slow and opaque; the founders say existing platforms hide suppliers and add markups.
business_model: Manufacturing marketplace: buyer submits one RFQ, Vendra routes to US suppliers and manages production; margin on parts

founders.name: Shan Mohta
founders.background_notes: YC bio: built hardware at Skydio, Apple and Microsoft.

founders.name: Anish Bhardwaj
founders.background_notes: YC bio: builds software. A third party profile calls him a childhood friend of the CEO (not opened).

competitors.name: Xometry
competitors.what: Online manufacturing marketplace for custom parts

competitors.name: Protolabs
competitors.what: Digital manufacturer of custom parts with instant quoting

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace and quoting workflow software plus supplier operations; the hard part is supplier quality and compliance, not research.

defensibility.rationale: ITAR registration and certifications (AS9100D, ISO 9001, NIST 800-171 per its site, current not founding) plus a vetted supplier network are slow to copy, but marketplaces are contestable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move against Vendra found; larger platforms continued to operate.

market_need_then: The YC launch framing cites complaints that existing platforms hide suppliers and mark up parts, plus demand from US defense and space hardware makers for domestic, ITAR compliant supply.

branding.domain_note: Uses vendra.io; the marketplace also appears under vendra-marketplace io per aggregators. Acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Patriotic, plain: Custom Parts, Manufactured in America with a US flag

branding.brand_signature: Made in America positioning with a flag emoji in the tagline

brand_strength.rationale: Clear domestic manufacturing message but no press on the brand or community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Vendra is an active Summer 2024 company serving defense and space hardware buyers, with a site claiming 20,000 plus parts delivered and strong on-time rates (self reported). No exit or failure was found. Funding is not verifiably public, so no success factors are asserted beyond the evident ITAR focus and named customers.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators show about 500K pre-seed or seed around 2024-08/09 (vcbacked, startupintros), Dealroom shows 125K, Preqin reports a Pioneer Fund investment in 2025-07 with undisclosed amount. Reported investors Pioneer Fund, Snow Leopard Ventures, Urban Innovation Fund come from yespress.io only. Founding year not stated in opened sources. Competitor list rests on the company's own YC launch framing; no independent dated coverage found. Completeness pass: the 2024-09 seed rests on Seedtable only (no amount) and the 2025-07 Pioneer Fund deal on Preqin only (amount undisclosed). VCBacked and Startups.fm give 500K total with pre-seed September 2024; Dealroom 125K; not summed. Total raised is unknown.
